title: Copper Flopper
description: Renames Copper Bulb to Copper Flopper
body:
In Mumbo Jumbo's video going over the copper bulb and renames it to the "Copper Flopper" so this makes the block name COPPER FLOPPER!

I personally have called this the copper flopper so many times I've tried typing it in the creative search bar, so now I can type "Copper Flopper"
